about: A signature narrows a ceiling and travels to every cell that rests on it as a meet, and meets commute, so the order of any number of signatures never shows in the field they leave.
Widening is not a meet and does not travel: asking for a wider ceiling leaves the cell where the narrower one put it, which is why an error costs a signature at every cell and a narrowing costs one.
Folding the field and signing it commute, with a withdrawal present.

cases.name: a chain of four and a fork of two
